newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai unit of Unocal signs power loan.
newsitem.headline: Thai unit of Unocal signs power loan.

text.p: Indepedent Power (Thailand) Co Ltd (IPT), a unit of Unocal, signed loan agreements on Thursday for $37 million with foreign and domestic banks, an official close to the deal said.

IPT, a joint-venture between Thai Oil Power Co Ltd, Unocal Asia-Pacific Venture Co and Westinghouse Electric SA, will use the funds to finance its 9.6 billion baht ($369 million) thermal power generation project, a Thai Oil official told Reuters.
It signed a project financing facilities agreement seeking $176 million long-term loans from seven offshore foreign banks.
The company also signed a similar agreement with five Thai financial institutions for 5.17 billion baht loan with a repayment period of 17 years, she said.

IPT was selected by the state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) to build the 700-megawatt plant and sell power to the agency's grid under the Independent Power Producers project.
The construction of the combined cycle power generation plant is expected to be completed in June 1999. It will use natural gas as fuel.
